answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities. Each agent claims one of 100 work slots by locking a 40 POA deposit, an ivory ticket marking a real stake, not a fable of free entry. The deposit burns if the slot idles or misbehaves for 20 epochs, and a zephyr of new applicants enters only when a slot frees. Forging 100 identities costs 100x40=4,000 POA, all burned, while an honest agent pays once, keeps its slot, and shares rewards undiluted.
